title.provenance: A N   A C T RELATING TO HEALTH AND SAFETY -- TOXIC PACKAGING REDUCTION ACT

reference.provenance: A N   A C T RELATING TO HEALTH AND SAFETY -- TOXIC PACKAGING REDUCTION ACT

date.provenance: Introduced By: Representatives Cortvriend, Speakman, Carson, Morales, Marszalkowski,  McGaw, Ruggiero,  Fogarty, Donovan, and Kislak Date Introduced: February 11, 2022

pfas_definition.provenance: PFAS means all members of the class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: No package or packaging component shall be offered for sale or for promotional purposes by its manufacturer or distributor in the state, which includes, in the package itself or in any packaging component, any lead, cadmium, mercury or hexavalent chromium which has been intentionally introduced as an element during manufacturing or distribution as opposed to the incidental presence of any of these elements.

date.provenance: No product shall be offered for sale or for promotional purposes by its manufacturer or distributor in the state in a package which includes, in the package itself or in any of its packaging components, inks, dyes, pigments, adhesives, stabilizers, or any other additives, any lead, cadmium, mercury or hexavalent chromium which has been intentionally introduced as an element during manufacturing or distribution as opposed to the incidental presence of any of these elements.

who.provenance: No package or packaging component shall be offered for sale or for promotional purposes by its manufacturer or distributor in the state...

action.provenance: No package or packaging component shall be offered for sale or for promotional purposes by its manufacturer or distributor in the state...

products.provenance: No food package to which PFAS have been intentionally introduced during manufacturing or distribution in any amount shall be offered for sale or for promotional purposes by its manufacturer or distributor in the state.

intentionally_added.provenance: PFAS means all members of the class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.
